claims: Vanderbilt University is located in Nashville, Tennessee.
Vanderbilt University is located in the West End neighborhood of midtown.
Vanderbilt University's campus is situated approximately 1.5 miles from downtown Nashville.
Vanderbilt University's main address is 2201 West End Ave, Nashville, TN 37235.
Vanderbilt University is an accredited arboretum.
Vanderbilt University is accessible from I-40 and I-65.
Vanderbilt University is expanding with a new campus in New York City.
Vanderbilt University has a future graduate campus planned for West Palm Beach.
Vanderbilt University's future graduate campus in West Palm Beach is set to open around 2029
